parameters.content:
## Contact List Merge
Upload the 6 exports in the form. Steps 1-6 follow the task note: map columns, clean + remove invalid, standardize (Rules tab), remove duplicates, enrich + merge, final output. Click a Code node to see its data. Removed rows: 'Removed Records (log)'. Merge log and review flags: 'Audit' node.

parameters.formDescription: Upload the 6 source exports. You get back ONE cleaned, de-duplicated contact list (xlsx).

options.formSubmittedText: Received. The merge is running: open this workflow's Executions list and download Final_Contact_List.xlsx from the 'Convert to Final_Contact_List.xlsx' node.
